title.zh: 公开访问、HTTPS 与重定向

description.en: Homepage reachable over HTTPS with sane redirects
description.zh: 首页可经 HTTPS 访问且重定向正常

description.en: robots.txt present, parseable, with rule groups
description.zh: robots.txt 存在、可解析、含规则组

description.en: Search / user-access / training declared separately
description.zh: 搜索、用户访问、训练三类分开声明

description.en: noindex/nosnippet-style directives on the homepage, including crawler-specific ones
description.zh: 首页的 noindex/nosnippet 类指令（含只针对某个爬虫的）

description.en: XML sitemap found (robots declaration or /sitemap.xml) and parseable
description.zh: 找到并解析 XML sitemap（robots 声明或 /sitemap.xml）

description.en: rel=canonical present and consistent with the final URL
description.zh: rel=canonical 存在且与最终 URL 一致

description.en: html lang declared on the homepage
description.zh: 首页声明 html lang

description.en: Descriptive title and meta description present
description.zh: 存在描述性的标题与 meta description

title.zh: 页面语义与可导航结构

description.en: Single h1, at least two subheadings, nav landmark, internal links
description.zh: 唯一 h1、至少两个小标题、nav 标记、站内链接

title.zh: 正文提取与 JS 依赖风险

description.en: Meaningful content present in initial HTML
description.zh: 初始 HTML 中含有实质内容

description.en: Parseable JSON-LD on the homepage
description.zh: 首页有可解析的 JSON-LD

title.zh: 结构化数据与可见内容一致性

description.en: JSON-LD names appear in visible content
description.zh: JSON-LD 名称出现在可见内容中

description.en: Organization JSON-LD, author, contact/about hints
description.zh: 组织 JSON-LD、作者、联系/关于线索

title.zh: 链接发现与 URL 可读取性

description.en: Crawlable internal links with anchor text
description.zh: 带锚文本的可爬取站内链接

description.en: Markdown twin via negotiation or .md variants
description.zh: 内容协商或 .md 变体提供 Markdown

description.en: Optional LLM-oriented index files
description.zh: 可选的 LLM 导读文件

description.en: Homepage HTML within practical fetch limits
description.zh: 首页 HTML 在实际抓取限制内

description.en: OpenAPI document and ai-plugin manifest at well-known paths
description.zh: 约定路径上的 OpenAPI 文档与 ai-plugin 清单

description.en: Link header / <link rel=alternate type=text/markdown> points at a fetchable markdown twin
description.zh: Link 头或 HTML alternate 指向可获取的 Markdown 副本

description.en: x-markdown-tokens / x-original-tokens headers on the markdown response
description.zh: Markdown 响应的 x-markdown-tokens / x-original-tokens 头

description.en: content-signal response header declaring AI usage preferences
description.zh: content-signal 响应头声明的 AI 使用偏好

description.en: /.well-known/api-catalog serves a valid linkset document
description.zh: /.well-known/api-catalog 返回合法 linkset 文档

title.zh: OAuth 受保护资源元数据（RFC 9728）

description.en: /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource with a resource field
description.zh: /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource 含 resource 字段

title.zh: OAuth 授权服务器元数据（RFC 8414）

description.en: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server with an issuer field
description.zh: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server 含 issuer 字段

description.en: A declared SKILL.md with valid agentskills.io frontmatter
description.zh: 声明的 SKILL.md 含合法 agentskills.io frontmatter

description.en: MCP server-card draft discovery via /.well-known/ai-catalog.json
description.zh: MCP server-card 草案的 /.well-known/ai-catalog.json 发现

description.en: /auth.md machine-readable authentication notes (WorkOS protocol)
description.zh: /auth.md 机器可读认证说明（WorkOS 协议）

description.en: /.well-known/ucp discovery profile
description.zh: /.well-known/ucp discovery profile

title.zh: 支付协议声明（x402 / MPP / ACP）

description.en: declaration-level only — read from fetched documents, no transactions
description.zh: 仅声明级——从已抓取文档读取，不发起交易

description.en: AID draft TXT records at _agent.<host> (SVCB DNS-AID not probed in this engine version)
description.zh: _agent.<host> 的 AID 草案 TXT 记录（本引擎版本不探测 SVCB DNS-AID）

description.en: /.well-known/ard.json manifest with an entries array
description.zh: /.well-known/ard.json manifest（entries 数组）

description.en: runtime JS API — reported unverified by a static scan
description.zh: 运行时 JS API——静态扫描如实标注未验证

description.en: crawler-side request signing — no site-side marker exists to probe
description.zh: 爬虫侧请求签名——站点侧无可探测标记

description.en: Open Graph and Twitter Card declarations
description.zh: Open Graph 与 Twitter Card 声明

description.en: RSS / Atom / JSON Feed link in the page head
description.zh: 页面 head 中的 RSS / Atom / JSON Feed 链接

description.en: icon / apple-touch-icon link in the page head
description.zh: 页面 head 中的 icon / apple-touch-icon 链接

description.en: Whether the page publishes a machine-readable date
description.zh: 页面是否发布了机器可读的日期

title.zh: 多页技术与元数据一致性

description.en: Unique titles/descriptions, canonicals and language across all content pages
description.zh: 所有内容页面的唯一标题/描述、canonical 与语言一致性

title.zh: 文档导航与内容可消费性

description.en: Nav landmarks, heading discipline and substance on content pages
description.zh: 内容页的导航标记、标题层级规范与内容充实度

title.zh: API / 电商公开信息完整性

description.en: Machine-readable API/product/offer data (site-type aware)
description.zh: 机器可读的 API/商品/报价数据（按站点类型判定）

title.zh: 跨页面品牌与实体信息一致性

description.en: One Organization/Brand identity (name, logo, sameAs) site-wide
description.zh: 全站统一的 Organization/Brand 身份（名称、logo、sameAs）

description.en: An indexable page has no title element.
description.zh: 可索引页面没有 title 元素。

description.en: Several indexable pages share the same title.
description.zh: 多个可索引页面使用了相同的标题。

description.en: No meta description; engines build the snippet from page text instead.
description.zh: 没有 meta description，引擎会改从正文生成摘要。

description.en: The page has no h1 element.
description.zh: 页面没有 h1 元素。

description.en: The page has more than one h1 element.
description.zh: 页面有多个 h1 元素。

description.en: The html element declares no language.
description.zh: html 元素没有声明语言。

description.en: The page declares no canonical URL.
description.zh: 页面没有声明 canonical URL。

title.zh: 图片缺少 alt 文本

description.en: Images without an alt attribute.
description.zh: 图片没有 alt 属性。

description.en: A JSON-LD block is not valid JSON; engines ignore it entirely.
description.zh: JSON-LD 块不是合法 JSON，引擎会整体忽略它。

description.en: Fewer than 300 visible words (heuristic).
description.zh: 可见文字少于 300 词（启发式）。

title.zh: 标题长度不在 30–60 字符内

description.en: Heuristic only: Google sets no fixed title length.
description.zh: 仅为启发式：Google 没有固定的标题长度要求。

description.en: HTML over 1 MB; many fetchers truncate around 1–2 MB.
description.zh: HTML 超过 1 MB，多数抓取器在 1–2 MB 处截断。

title.en: Structured data type no longer shown
title.zh: 结构化数据类型已不再展示

description.en: Google no longer shows rich results for this type (HowTo, FAQPage, SpecialAnnouncement, ClaimReview). Keeping it does no harm but earns nothing in Search.
description.zh: Google 已不再为此类型（HowTo、FAQPage、SpecialAnnouncement、ClaimReview）展示富媒体结果。保留标记无害，但在搜索中没有收益。

title.zh: 结构化数据缺少必需属性

description.en: A JSON-LD item lacks a property Google requires for its rich result type, so the page is not eligible for that result.
description.zh: JSON-LD 条目缺少 Google 对该富媒体结果类型要求的属性，页面因此无法获得该结果。

description.en: A JSON-LD block has no @context naming schema.org, so its types and properties are not schema.org terms and search engines ignore it.
description.zh: JSON-LD 块没有指向 schema.org 的 @context，其中的类型和属性就不是 schema.org 词汇，搜索引擎会忽略它。

title.en: Sitemap lists a page that is not in the build
title.zh: Sitemap 列出了构建中不存在的页面

description.en: A same-origin sitemap URL maps to no file in the build output and will 404.
description.zh: Sitemap 中的同源 URL 在构建产物里没有对应文件，上线后会 404。

title.zh: Sitemap 列出了 noindex 页面

description.en: A sitemap URL carries noindex (meta robots or X-Robots-Tag): conflicting signals.
description.zh: Sitemap 中的页面带有 noindex（meta robots 或 X-Robots-Tag），信号互相矛盾。

title.zh: Sitemap 列出了非规范 URL

description.en: The page at a sitemap URL declares a different canonical URL.
description.zh: Sitemap 中 URL 对应的页面声明了另一个 canonical。

title.zh: Sitemap URL 指向其他主机

description.en: A sitemap entry points at a host other than the site origin (localhost, preview or wrong domain).
description.zh: Sitemap 条目指向站点来源以外的主机（localhost、预览域名或错误域名）。

title.zh: Sitemap URL 被 robots.txt 屏蔽

description.en: robots.txt disallows a URL the sitemap asks engines to crawl.
description.zh: robots.txt 禁止了 sitemap 要求抓取的 URL。

description.en: The build ships a sitemap that robots.txt does not reference.
description.zh: 构建产物包含 sitemap，但 robots.txt 没有引用它。

title.en: Indexable page missing from the sitemap
title.zh: 可索引页面不在 sitemap 中

description.en: A self-canonical, indexable page is not listed in any sitemap.
description.zh: 自引用 canonical 的可索引页面没有出现在任何 sitemap 中。

description.en: The canonical URL uses a host other than the site origin.
description.zh: canonical URL 使用了站点来源以外的主机。

title.en: Canonical target is not in the build

description.en: The canonical URL maps to no file in the build output.
description.zh: canonical URL 在构建产物中没有对应文件。

description.en: The page names a canonical URL whose page is noindex.
description.zh: 页面声明的 canonical 目标页面带有 noindex。

description.en: The canonical target itself declares another canonical URL.
description.zh: canonical 目标页面又声明了另一个 canonical。

title.en: hreflang target is not in the build

description.en: An hreflang alternate maps to no file in the build output.
description.zh: hreflang 备选 URL 在构建产物中没有对应文件。

description.en: Page A lists page B as an alternate but B does not list A; engines ignore the pair.
description.zh: A 页面把 B 列为备选，但 B 没有回指 A，引擎会忽略这一对标注。

description.en: An hreflang value is not a valid language(-region) code or x-default.
description.zh: hreflang 值不是有效的语言（-地区）代码或 x-default。

title.en: hreflang set does not include the page itself
title.zh: hreflang 组未包含页面自身

description.en: Each language version should list itself among its alternates.
description.zh: 每个语言版本都应在备选中列出自身。

description.en: An internal link points at a path with no file and no matching redirect.
description.zh: 站内链接指向的路径既没有文件，也没有匹配的重定向。

description.en: An indexable page has no internal links pointing to it.
description.zh: 可索引页面没有任何站内链接指向它。

title.en: llms.txt links to a missing page
title.zh: llms.txt 链接到不存在的页面

description.en: A same-origin llms.txt link maps to no file in the build output.
description.zh: llms.txt 中的同源链接在构建产物中没有对应文件。

title.en: llms.txt links to a noindex or non-canonical page
title.zh: llms.txt 链接到 noindex 或非规范页面

description.en: llms.txt points readers at a page that engines are told not to index or to replace.
description.zh: llms.txt 引导读者访问的页面被要求不索引或被其他规范页取代。

title.en: Markdown alternate is not in the build
title.zh: Markdown 备选版本不在构建中

description.en: A <link rel=alternate type=text/markdown> target maps to no file.
description.zh: <link rel=alternate type=text/markdown> 的目标没有对应文件。

description.en: `User-agent: *` disallows `/` — usually a staging robots.txt shipped to production.
description.zh: `User-agent: *` 禁止了 `/`，通常是把测试环境的 robots.txt 发布到了生产环境。

title.zh: robots.txt 屏蔽了 AI 搜索爬虫

description.en: An AI search crawler (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot…) may not fetch `/`, which removes the site from that engine's answers.
description.zh: AI 搜索爬虫（OAI-SearchBot、Claude-SearchBot、PerplexityBot 等）不能抓取 `/`，站点会因此从该引擎的回答中消失。

title.zh: 框架配置声明了另一个站点来源

description.en: The production origin in the framework config differs from the origin being checked; canonical URLs, sitemaps and feeds generated from it point at the wrong host.
description.zh: 框架配置里的正式站点来源与本次检查的来源不一致；据此生成的 canonical、sitemap 和订阅源会指向错误的主机。

title.en: Base path missing from canonical URLs
title.zh: canonical URL 缺少 base 路径

description.en: The framework serves the site under a base path, but canonical URLs omit it and point at paths outside the site.
description.zh: 框架把站点部署在某个 base 路径下，但 canonical URL 没带这个前缀，指向了站点之外的路径。

title.zh: URL 与尾斜杠设置相矛盾

description.en: Canonical or sitemap URLs use the trailing-slash form the framework does not serve; each one costs a redirect or splits signals between two URLs.
description.zh: canonical 或 sitemap 中的 URL 用的是框架不提供的尾斜杠形式；每个这样的 URL 都要多一次跳转，或者把信号分散到两个 URL 上。

description.en: Redirect rules send a URL back to itself; browsers and crawlers give up and the URL never resolves.
description.zh: 重定向规则让一个 URL 绕回自身；浏览器和爬虫都会放弃，这个 URL 永远打不开。

description.en: A redirect leads to another redirect. Point the first rule straight at the final URL.
description.zh: 一个重定向又跳到另一个重定向。应让第一条规则直接指向最终 URL。

title.zh: 重定向到不存在的页面

description.en: A redirect rule sends visitors to a path on this site that the build does not serve (404).
description.zh: 重定向规则把访问者送到本站一个构建产物里不存在的路径（404）。

title.en: Header rule sets noindex on pages
title.zh: 响应头规则给页面加了 noindex

description.en: A _headers / vercel.json / netlify.toml / Next.js header rule adds X-Robots-Tag: noindex to HTML pages; search engines drop them from the index.
description.zh: _headers、vercel.json、netlify.toml 或 Next.js 的响应头规则给 HTML 页面加了 X-Robots-Tag: noindex，搜索引擎会把这些页面移出索引。

title.en: Config not applied by static export
title.zh: 静态导出不会应用的配置

description.en: Next.js static export (output: "export") does not apply redirects, rewrites or headers from next.config; configure them on the host.
description.zh: Next.js 静态导出（output: "export"）不会应用 next.config 里的 redirects、rewrites 和 headers，需要在托管平台上配置。

title.en: Routes served by one client-rendered shell
title.zh: 所有路由共用一个客户端渲染的空壳

description.en: Many URLs are answered by the same HTML shell that renders in the browser. Crawlers that do not run JavaScript, most AI crawlers among them, see the shell only: the same title, canonical and no content. Prerender or server-render the pages.
description.zh: 许多 URL 返回的是同一个在浏览器里渲染的 HTML 空壳。不执行 JavaScript 的爬虫（包括大多数 AI 爬虫）只能看到这个空壳：同样的标题、同样的 canonical、没有正文。应改为预渲染或服务端渲染。

title.zh: 可索引页面被删除且没有重定向

description.en: A page that was indexable in the baseline is gone and no redirect covers it.
description.zh: 基线中可索引的页面已不存在，也没有重定向承接。

description.en: A page that was indexable in the baseline now carries noindex.
description.zh: 基线中可索引的页面现在带有 noindex。

description.en: The page's canonical URL differs from the baseline.
description.zh: 页面的 canonical URL 与基线不同。

description.en: Alternates present in the baseline are no longer declared.
description.zh: 基线中的 hreflang 备选不再声明。

description.en: A JSON-LD @type present in the baseline is gone.
description.zh: 基线中的 JSON-LD @type 已消失。

description.en: Visible words dropped by half or more versus the baseline.
description.zh: 可见文字比基线减少一半或更多。

title.zh: URL 从 sitemap 中移除

description.en: A URL listed in the baseline sitemap is no longer listed while the page still exists.
description.zh: 基线 sitemap 中的 URL 已被移除，但页面仍然存在。

description.en: The number of indexable pages fell by 10% or more versus the baseline.
description.zh: 可索引页面数量比基线下降 10% 或更多。

title.en: Crawler blocked by the server or CDN
title.zh: 爬虫被服务器或 CDN 拦截

description.en: Most requests from a known crawler are answered 401, 403 or 429. A WAF, bot-protection or rate-limit rule is turning it away, so the pages cannot be indexed or cited by that service.
description.zh: 某个已知爬虫的大部分请求都收到 401、403 或 429。WAF、防机器人或限流规则把它挡在了门外，这个服务就无法收录或引用这些页面。

description.en: A known crawler receives 5xx responses on a noticeable share of its requests. Repeated server errors make crawlers slow down and drop URLs.
description.zh: 某个已知爬虫有相当比例的请求收到 5xx。反复出现服务器错误会让爬虫降低抓取频率并丢弃 URL。

description.en: Crawlers requesting /robots.txt got a 5xx or 429. Google then treats the whole site as disallowed until robots.txt is reachable again.
description.zh: 爬虫请求 /robots.txt 时收到 5xx 或 429。此时 Google 会把整站当作禁止抓取，直到 robots.txt 恢复可访问。

description.en: On one day crawlers hit far more 404s than usual — typically a deploy that removed or moved URLs without redirects.
description.zh: 某一天爬虫遇到的 404 远多于平时，通常是某次部署删除或移动了 URL 却没有加重定向。

description.en: Requests carry a known crawler's user agent but come from addresses outside its published IP ranges (or fail reverse-DNS verification). Do not allow-list by user agent alone.
description.zh: 这些请求使用已知爬虫的 User-Agent，但来源地址不在其公布的 IP 段内（或反向 DNS 验证失败）。不要只按 User-Agent 放行。

title.zh: 爬虫抓取了被禁止的路径

description.en: A verified crawler fetched paths that the build's robots.txt disallows for it. Either robots.txt changed after those fetches or the rule does not say what you intend.
description.zh: 经过验证的爬虫抓取了当前构建的 robots.txt 禁止它访问的路径。可能是 robots.txt 在这些抓取之后才改过，也可能是规则写得和本意不一致。

title.en: AI search crawlers reach few pages
title.zh: AI 搜索爬虫覆盖的页面很少

description.en: In the log window, AI search crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and others) fetched only a small share of the indexable pages, so answer engines are working from few or stale copies.
description.zh: 在日志时间窗内，AI 搜索爬虫（OAI-SearchBot、Claude-SearchBot、PerplexityBot 等）只抓取了很少一部分可索引页面，答案引擎手里的副本很少或已经过时。

title.en: Indexable page not in Google's index
title.zh: 可索引页面未被 Google 收录

description.en: URL Inspection reports this indexable build page as not indexed (for example "Crawled – currently not indexed" or "Discovered – currently not indexed").
description.zh: URL 检查显示，构建产物中这个可索引页面未被收录（例如“已抓取 - 尚未编入索引”或“已发现 - 尚未编入索引”）。

title.zh: Google 选择了另一个规范网址

description.en: The page declares itself canonical, but Google selected a different URL as canonical, so this page's signals go to that one.
description.zh: 页面声明自己是规范网址，但 Google 选了另一个 URL 作为规范网址，这个页面的信号会归到那个 URL。

title.en: Production answers differently than the build
title.zh: 线上返回与构建产物不一致

description.en: For a page the build serves and allows, Google's last fetch was blocked by robots.txt or did not succeed (404, 5xx, access denied) — the deployment, CDN or host rules differ from what was built.
description.zh: 构建产物中存在且允许抓取的页面，Google 最近一次抓取却被 robots.txt 拦截或没有成功（404、5xx、拒绝访问）——部署、CDN 或托管规则与构建结果不一致。

description.en: The page's clicks from Google Search fell by half or more against the previous period of the same length.
description.zh: 这个页面来自 Google 搜索的点击量比上一个同长度周期下降了一半或更多。

description.en: The configured IndexNow key is not in the build or the live site does not serve it, so engines reject submissions (HTTP 403).
description.zh: 配置的 IndexNow 密钥不在构建产物中，或线上站点没有提供它，搜索引擎会拒绝提交（HTTP 403）。
